scenario: A 7-year-old boy with known peanut allergy presents with wheeze, rash, and increased work of breathing after eating birthday cake. He has ongoing anaphylaxis requiring epinephrine, fluids, bronchodilator treatment, possible epinephrine infusion, and airway management for worsening airway obstruction with possible laryngospasm during intubation.
